text:
marta: quick heads-up — opening a docs PR to add a small SOC2 data dictionary section + examples for audit events. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Need alignment on terminology (tenant_id vs org_id) and retention wording.
lee: thanks — pinging security@, can we standardize on `tenant_id` (we use tenant_id in logs) ? also note we should include redaction example for PII.
sam: legal prefers "tenant" not "customer" in SOC2 language. Also keep retention phrasing as 'retained for up to X days' (avoid 'we delete after').
kai: quick SDK snippet for Go currently shows `user_id` in examples — I'll open a small PR to replace with `pseudonym_id` and add comment about hashing. won't be long.
marta: awesome. here's a proposed event example:
```json
{"event_type":"api.request","tenant_id":"TENANT_123","actor_role":"system","resource":"/v1/generate","timestamp":"2024-11-05T12:34:56Z","meta":{"request_id":"r-abc123"}}
```
please note we purposely omit `user_input` field; link to retention table: https://redwood/docs/security/retention
lee: add a short snippet showing redaction rule:
```
if event.containsPII:
  event.user_input = "<redacted>"
```
also can we add a footnote about KMS rotation and exportability?
marta: yes, will add a footnote and cross-link to KMS page. kai — can you paste your PR number for the SDK snippet change?
kai: PR 4325. small change, tests passing. cc @docs-bot for deploy preview
docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/4321
sam: LGTM from legal on wording, just one tiny tweak: change 'retained for up to 90 days' -> 'retained for no longer than 90 days'.
lee: +1 from security, and add note about tenant-scoped exports for SOC2 audits.
marta: great — I'll merge once PRs 4321 and 4325 land, then make a follow-up issue to sweep other snippets. thanks all :tada:
